title: The Master Has Come
lyrics_original: And He calls us to follow
We love Him and seek Him,
We long to be near Him,
But God who does lead us
We run hard to hold Him,
He seeks us and finds us

bible_verses.english: He said to them, "Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men."
Jesus said to him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me."
For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for calling me by name and inviting me to walk alongside You. When the road ahead feels steep or shadow-filled, help me to see the clear prints of Your love guiding my steps. Give me a trusting heart to follow wherever You lead, knowing You are bringing me home to Your eternal day. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Jesus doesn't just point out the path from a distance; He walks it ahead of us, leaving His footprints for us to follow. Whether our journey takes us across high mountain peaks of joy or through deep valleys of uncertainty, His gentle call remains constant. As we sing these words, we are invited to trust the Shepherd who knows every step of the way. Let us fix our eyes on Him today, stepping forward with courage toward the eternal light of His presence.
